newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA says appoints Kennedy chairman.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA says appoints Kennedy chairman.

text.p: Gaming machine maker AWA Ltd said on Monday it had appointed Trevor Kennedy as chairman to replace John Iliffe who has resigned from the board.
AWA said it has also appointed Michael Cole and Ian Hunter to the board. It said David Greatorex, David Parkin, Grahame Campbell and Robert Frater had also resigned from the board.
Earlier, AWA reported an operating loss after abnormal items and tax of A$15.7 million for the six months ended December 31 compared with a profit of A$1.54 million a year earlier.
